copilot /compact around two normal turns. UNLIKE the rest of this row, copilot writes an EXPLICIT compaction boundary into the very file irrlicht tails: compactHistory emits session.compaction_start and session.compaction_complete via this.emit (non-ephemeral), and the session event writer subscribes to on("*") with no allow-list, so both land in session-state/<id>/events.jsonl. A manual /compact emits NO user.message and NO assistant.turn_start/turn_end (the TUI arm calls commands.invoke({name:"compact"}) directly), so those two events are the ONLY signal of the summarization call. core/adapters/inbound/agents/copilot/parser.go has no arm for either type — both hit `default: ev.Skip = true` — so today the row holds `ready` for the whole LLM call while copilot's own TUI shows a compacting spinner. This spec therefore asserts the CORRECT arc (compact_start=working, compact_end=ready) and is marked known_failing; the unlock is two switch arms (compaction_start -> activity, compaction_complete -> turn_done), needing neither IsManualCompactBoundary nor the SignalCompactInProgress hook overlay claudecode uses. Single-birth anchoring with the first phase UNPINNED, matching this column: copilot creates the session directory at launch but events.jsonl only at the first prompt. Auto/background compaction is a different, benign shape (pre-request processor inside a turn, emits only session.compaction_complete kind:"background") and is deliberately NOT exercised — forcing it would mean filling a 272k window. observations.model is left unpinned: this account reaches only gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4.5, --model accepts only "auto", and the router reports its pick on session.auto_mode_resolved.

KNOWN_FAILING CLEARED 2026-08-05 (CLI 1.0.78) — BY A RE-RECORDING, NOT A SPEC REBASE. The cell was frozen daemon_capability=bug because parser.go's default arm Skipped both session.compaction_start and session.compaction_complete, so the row held `ready` for the whole summarization call while copilot's own TUI showed a compacting spinner. The parser now maps compaction_start → "compaction_start" (activity) and compaction_complete → "turn_done", pinned red-first by TestCompactionHoldsSessionWorking. This recording is the live proof, from the daemon's own transitions: session.compaction_start lands at 15:34:33.028 and the session goes ready → working at 17:34:33.165; it HOLDS working for 13.1 seconds across the summarization LLM call; session.compaction_complete lands at 15:34:46.116 and settles it back to ready at 17:34:46.240. A following prompt then drives the SAME session id working → ready again (17:34:54.358 → 17:35:03.527), which is what proves compaction is in-place: no new session row, no id rotation. Unlike Claude Code this needed neither IsManualCompactBoundary nor the hook-driven SignalCompactInProgress overlay — copilot puts the boundary on disk.
